takeaway: Shaping of the hands and feet in limb development happens through apoptosis during a critical period of about 4 weeks.

question.text: With regard to development of the limbs:
question.say: With regard to development of the limbs, which statement is true?

answer.text: Shaping of the hands and feet is brought about through apoptosis
answer.say: The answer: shaping of the hands and feet is brought about through apoptosis.

lines.text: A potter sculpts a hand on the wheel: the developing limb.
lines.say: A potter sculpts a hand on his wheel. This is the developing limb.

lines.text: The little sparkling cells carve out the fingers: apoptosis.
lines.say: The sparkling cells carve out the fingers, between them. This is apoptosis, programmed cell death.

lines.text: Limb development takes place over a 4-week period.
lines.say: Limb development takes place over a four-week period.

lines.text: By the end of the eighth week all components are distinct.
lines.say: By the end of the eighth week, all the components of the upper and lower limbs are distinct.

lines.text: In this critical period teratogens can cause limb anomalies.
lines.say: During this critical period the limb is susceptible to environmental teratogens, resulting in limb anomalies.

lines.text: Remember: apoptosis shapes the hands and feet.
lines.say: Remember: apoptosis shapes the hands and feet.
